description.en:
Crane auto-aim for the Rottne H21D (from the Rottne Pack, needed).
Drive up to a tree: a ring shows on the tree you can fell (yellow = in reach, green = head on the tree, red = too thick or not allowed). Hold Q: the crane swings to the tree, reaches in, lowers the head until it touches the ground, cuts the tree and lifts it (saw about 2.25 m above the ground), ready to back out. Let go of Q to stop at any time. O (the game's own auto-aim key) aims only, so you can cut yourself. Left Shift + Q: centre the crane. Folds the telescope, arms and head back to their start position, then swings crane and cab back to straight ahead. Uses the game's own auto-aim, with the base-game John Deere 1270G settings.
